name: daily_entry_template
sql:
CREATE TABLE daily_entry_template (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  entry_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(entry_type IN ('EXPENSE','INCOME')),
  display_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(display_name))>0),
  normalized_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(normalized_name)>0),
  source_record_id TEXT REFERENCES ledger_entry(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  product_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  product_name_snapshot TEXT,
  primary_category_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  primary_category_name_snapshot TEXT,
  secondary_category_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  secondary_category_name_snapshot TEXT,
  unit_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  unit_name_snapshot TEXT,
  purchase_channel_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  purchase_channel_name_snapshot TEXT,
  location_label_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  location_label_name_snapshot TEXT,
  income_category_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  income_category_name_snapshot TEXT,
  payer_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  payer_name_snapshot TEXT,
  unit_price_scaled INTEGER CHECK(unit_price_scaled BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999999),
  quantity_scaled INTEGER CHECK(quantity_scaled BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999),
  amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents BETWEEN 0 AND 99999999999),
  funding_channel_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  funding_channel_name_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL,
  last_used_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(julianday(last_used_at) IS NOT NULL),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(julianday(created_at) IS NOT NULL),
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(julianday(updated_at) IS NOT NULL),
  row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(row_version>0), income_name TEXT,
  UNIQUE(entry_type,normalized_name),
  CHECK((entry_type='EXPENSE' AND product_id IS NOT NULL AND product_name_snapshot IS NOT NULL
    AND primary_category_id IS NOT NULL AND primary_category_name_snapshot IS NOT NULL
    AND unit_id IS NOT NULL AND unit_name_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND unit_price_scaled IS NOT NULL AND quantity_scaled IS NOT NULL
    AND payer_id IS NULL AND income_category_id IS NULL)
    OR (entry_type='INCOME' AND product_id IS NULL AND primary_category_id IS NULL AND secondary_category_id IS NULL
    AND unit_id IS NULL AND unit_price_scaled IS NULL AND quantity_scaled IS NULL
    AND purchase_channel_id IS NULL AND location_label_id IS NULL
    AND payer_id IS NOT NULL AND payer_name_snapshot IS NOT NULL
    AND income_category_id IS NOT NULL AND income_category_name_snapshot IS NOT NULL AND amount_cents>0))
) STRICT

name: dictionary_item
sql:
CREATE TABLE dictionary_item (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('PRODUCT','EXPENSE_CATEGORY','UNIT','FUNDING_CHANNEL','PURCHASE_CHANNEL','PAYER','INCOME_CATEGORY','LOCATION_LABEL')),
 name TEXT NOT NULL,
 normalized_name TEXT NOT NULL,
 parent_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','INACTIVE')),
 sort_order INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(row_version>0),
 seed_key TEXT,
 seed_version INTEGER,
 CHECK(parent_id IS NULL OR (kind='EXPENSE_CATEGORY' AND parent_id<>id))
) STRICT

 amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents BETWEEN 1 AND 99999999999),
 business_time TEXT NOT NULL,
 business_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EFFECTIVE' CHECK(status IN ('EFFECTIVE','REVOKED','TRASHED','SOURCE_FROZEN')),
 note TEXT CHECK(note IS NULL OR length(note)<=500),
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(row_version>0),
 deleted_at TEXT,
 purge_after TEXT, search_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 CHECK((status='TRASHED' AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND purge_after IS NOT NULL)
   OR (status<>'TRASHED' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND purge_after IS NULL))
) STRICT

CREATE TABLE ledger_entry (

 business_time TEXT NOT NULL,
 business_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 row_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(row_version>0),
 lifecycle_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK(lifecycle_status IN ('ACTIVE','TRASHED')),
 deleted_at TEXT,
 purge_after TEXT, product_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, product_name_snapshot TEXT, primary_category_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, primary_category_name_snapshot TEXT, secondary_category_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, secondary_category_name_snapshot TEXT, unit_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, unit_name_snapshot TEXT, purchase_channel_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, purchase_channel_name_snapshot TEXT, location_label_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, location_label_name_snapshot TEXT, income_category_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, income_category_name_snapshot TEXT, payer_id TEXT REFERENCES dictionary_item(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, payer_name_snapshot TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1970-01-01T00:00:00.000Z', unit_price_scaled INTEGER CHECK(unit_price_scaled IS NULL OR unit_price_scaled BETWEEN 0 AND 999999999999), quantity_scaled INTEGER CHECK(quantity_scaled IS NULL OR quantity_scaled BETWEEN 1 AND 999999999), calculated_amount_cents INTEGER CHECK(calculated_amount_cents IS NULL OR calculated_amount_cents BETWEEN 0 AND 99999999999), income_name TEXT CHECK(income_name IS NULL OR length(income_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200), normalized_income_name TEXT, note TEXT CHECK(note IS NULL OR length(note)<=500), updated_at TEXT, normalized_product_name_snapshot TEXT, search_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', adjustment_source_search_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',

name: adjustment_validate_insert
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER adjustment_validate_insert BEFORE INSERT ON expense_adjustment BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry WHERE id=NEW.original_expense_id AND entry_type='EXPENSE')
   OR (NEW.status='EFFECTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry WHERE id=NEW.original_expense_id AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE'))
   OR (NEW.status='EFFECTIVE' AND NEW.amount_cents+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM expense_adjustment WHERE original_expense_id=NEW.original_expense_id AND status='EFFECTIVE'),0)>(SELECT amount_cents FROM ledger_entry WHERE id=NEW.original_expense_id))
   THEN RAISE(ABORT,'adjustment source or total invalid') END;
END

name: adjustment_validate_update
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER adjustment_validate_update BEFORE UPDATE ON expense_adjustment BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.original_expense_id<>OLD.original_expense_id
   OR (NEW.status='EFFECTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ledger_entry WHERE id=NEW.original_expense_id AND lifecycle_status='ACTIVE'))
   OR (NEW.status='EFFECTIVE' AND NEW.amount_cents+COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM expense_adjustment WHERE original_expense_id=NEW.original_expense_id AND id<>NEW.id AND status='EFFECTIVE'),0)>(SELECT amount_cents FROM ledger_entry WHERE id=NEW.original_expense_id))
   THEN RAISE(ABORT,'adjustment source or total invalid') END;
END

dictionary_category_status
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER dictionary_category_status BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON dictionary_item WHEN NEW.kind='EXPENSE_CATEGORY'
BEGIN
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.status='INACTIVE' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dictionary_item c WHERE c.parent_id=NEW.id AND c.status='ACTIVE')
    THEN RAISE(ABORT,'active category children exist') END;
  SELECT CASE WHEN NEW.status='ACTIVE' AND NEW.parent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dictionary_item p WHERE p.id=NEW.parent_id AND p.status='ACTIVE')
    THEN RAISE(ABORT,'category parent is inactive') END;
END

name: dictionary_identity_immutable
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER dictionary_identity_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF kind,parent_id ON dictionary_item
WHEN NEW.kind<>OLD.kind OR NEW.parent_id IS NOT OLD.parent_id
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'dictionary identity is immutable');
END

END

name: ledger_adjustment_minimum
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_adjustment_minimum BEFORE UPDATE OF amount_cents,lifecycle_status ON ledger_entry
 WHEN NEW.entry_type='EXPENSE' AND NEW.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE' BEGIN
 SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_cents) FROM expense_adjustment WHERE original_expense_id=NEW.id
   AND (status='EFFECTIVE' OR (OLD.lifecycle_status='TRASHED' AND status='SOURCE_FROZEN'))),0)>NEW.amount_cents
   THEN RAISE(ABORT,'expense below adjustment total') END;
END

ledger_freeze_adjustments
sql:
CREATE TRIGGER ledger_freeze_adjustments AFTER UPDATE OF lifecycle_status ON ledger_entry
 WHEN NEW.entry_type='EXPENSE' AND OLD.lifecycle_status<>NEW.lifecycle_status BEGIN
 UPDATE expense_adjustment SET status='SOURCE_FROZEN',updated_at=NEW.updated_at,row_version=row_version+1
   WHERE original_expense_id=NEW.id AND status='EFFECTIVE' AND NEW.lifecycle_status='TRASHED';
 UPDATE expense_adjustment SET status='EFFECTIVE',updated_at=NEW.updated_at,row_version=row_version+1
   WHERE original_expense_id=NEW.id AND status='SOURCE_FROZEN' AND NEW.lifecycle_status='ACTIVE';
END
